title: Two-dimensional matter-wave interferometer, rotational dynamics, and spin contrast
summary: We investigate a two-dimensional matter-wave interferometer where both spatial and rotational dynamics of a nanoparticle are intertwined in closing the one-loop interferometer in the Stern-Gerlach type setup. We consider the spin-contrast of the nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centred nanodiamond in combination with a two-dimensional magnetic field setup to extend the one-dimensional Stern--Gerlach interferometry.
